concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading and preprocessing *at least three* public scRNA‑seq datasets. Tasks T004 and T005 allow the pipeline to proceed with fewer (or a single) dataset by falling back to a descriptive case‑study mode, which does not satisfy the mandatory three‑dataset requirement.

FR-003 mandates computation of the Local Continuity (LCA) metric. Task T005 implements “local continuity” as the reverse Trustworthiness metric, which is not the specified LCA metric, leaving FR‑003 uncovered.

FR-006 mandates fitting a mixed‑effects model. Task T008 conditionally fits a fixed‑effects ANOVA when fewer than two datasets are available, meaning the mixed‑effects model is not guaranteed, violating the FR‑006 requirement.
